# Pak Multilinks Hygiene

> Wholesale hygiene and cleaning products supplier in Lahore, Pakistan. Over 150 real products for businesses, offices, hotels, and institutions.

Pak Multilinks Hygiene (https://pakmultilinks.com) is a wholesale supplier of tissue, cleaning, washroom, personal care, and disposable products based at Shop No LG-9, Rehman Tower, Main Market Gulberg II, Lahore, Pakistan.

## Key facts

- Business type: Wholesale hygiene supplies (B2B)
- Location: Lahore, Pakistan (ships nationwide)
- Catalog: 150+ products across 5 categories
- Brands stocked: Dettol, Harpic, Vim, Surf Excel, Ariel, Rose Petal, Lux, Lifebuoy, Safeguard, Colgate, and more
- Minimum order: 1 carton per product
- Ordering: website cart, WhatsApp, or quotation form
- Contacts: Zoher Ahmed (+92 300 6917 385), M. Bilal Shah, BDO (+92 325 8166829)

## Categories

- Tissue & Paper Wholesale: facial tissues, toilet rolls, kitchen towels, napkins
- Washroom Supplies: mops, brushes, dispensers, buckets, gloves
- Cleaning Products: floor cleaners, bleach, detergents, dishwash, insect killers, air fresheners
- Personal Care: soaps, shampoos, toothpaste, handwash, deodorants, shaving
- Disposable Items: cups, plates, cutlery, garbage bags, masks, wipes
